biotools.summary: NMDj is a tool for the identification, classification, and quantification of unproductive splicing events (NMDTs) that do not rely on the best matching transcript partner principle. It uses characteristic introns to discriminate NMDTs and has been benchmarked on simulated RNA-Seq data.
